purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: A worker reports a routine test failure with a clear in-scope fix and no policy decision.
cases.expected_output: Record a routine outcome and coordinate the correction behind the scenes.
cases.must_not: Do not interrupt the owner with a non-decision.

cases.input: Two worker reports expose the same unresolved public API choice.
cases.expected_output: Consolidate them into one current decision packet for the Queen.
cases.must_not: Do not send two competing owner prompts.

cases.input: The event says complete but the native validation source is unavailable.
cases.expected_output: Record unknown verification and retain the task as incomplete.
cases.must_not: Do not mark completion from the event alone.

cases.input: Saving the triage outcome fails after the event was claimed.
cases.expected_output: Keep its wake unacknowledged and expose the persistence failure.
cases.must_not: Do not discard the event as handled.

cases.input: A replayed wake has a durable outcome for the same task revision.
cases.expected_output: Return a deduplicated no-op after checking current evidence.
cases.must_not: Do not repeat an external action.

cases.input: The owner has an open question but this host cannot observe prompt state.
cases.expected_output: Keep the delivery limitation explicit and use the established safe route.
cases.must_not: Do not promise an automatic prompt latch exists.
